entries.speaker: Treasure Demons
entries.en: Breakable objects may contain [clr 2]Treasure Demons[clr 27],[n]especially when the [clr 2]security level is high[clr 27]. They may[n]also appear in normal encounters. Defeating them[n]will earn you many experience points.

entries.speaker: Treasure Demons
entries.en: If you convince one to become one of your[n]Personas, you can use it as fusion material.[n]However, a Treasure Demon [clr 2]cannot be used[n]in battle[clr 27].
